extraMeanings.en: a small piece of land marked out for a purpose
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They bought a small plot of land to build their house.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ev yapmak için küçük bir arsa satın aldılar.

extraMeanings.en: to make something smooth and shiny by rubbing
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He polished his shoes until they shone.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ayakkabılarını parlayana kadar cilaladı.

extraMeanings.en: to improve a skill or piece of work
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She spent the evening polishing her presentation.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Akşamı sunumunu geliştirerek geçirdi.

extraMeanings.en: to divide something into parts and share it out
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The nurse portioned out the medicine carefully.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hemşire ilacı dikkatlice pay etti.

extraMeanings.en: to cause a problem or danger
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The chemical waste poses a serious threat to the river.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kimyasal atık nehir için ciddi bir tehlike oluşturuyor.

extraMeanings.en: to sit or stand in a particular position to be photographed
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The models posed for the photographers.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Mankenler fotoğrafçılara poz verdi.

extraMeanings.en: to investigate or examine something closely
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Journalists began to probe into the company's finances.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Gazeteciler şirketin mali durumunu araştırmaya başladı.

extraMeanings.en: to prepare someone for a situation, especially by giving them information
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The lawyer primed the witness before the trial.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Avukat, duruşmadan önce tanığı hazırladı.

extraMeanings.en: to make light, an image, or a shadow fall on a surface
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The film was projected onto a large screen.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Film büyük bir ekrana yansıtıldı.

extraMeanings.en: to estimate or forecast something based on current data
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Experts project that the population will double by 2050.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Uzmanlar nüfusun 2050'ye kadar iki katına çıkacağını öngörüyor.

extraMeanings.en: to make a small hole in something with a sharp point
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She pricked her finger on a needle.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Parmağını bir iğneye batırdı.

extraMeanings.en: a serious promise or agreement
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The government made a pledge to reduce carbon emissions.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hükümet karbon emisyonlarını azaltacağına dair söz verdi.

extraMeanings.en: to decrease suddenly and quickly in amount or value
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Share prices plunged after the announcement.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Duyurunun ardından hisse fiyatları çakıldı.

extraMeanings.en: to push something suddenly and forcefully into something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He plunged his hand into the cold water.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Elini soğuk suya daldırdı.

extraMeanings.en: to make someone decide to do something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The bad reviews prompted the company to change its policy.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kötü eleştiriler şirketi politikasını değiştirmeye yöneltti.

extraMeanings.en: to help someone by suggesting words they have forgotten
extraMeanings.exampleEn: When the actor forgot his lines, someone prompted him from offstage.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Oyuncu repliklerini unutunca biri kulisten ona suflörlük yaptı.

extraMeanings.en: to search an area for gold, oil, or other valuable substances
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Miners came west to prospect for gold.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Madenciler altın aramak için batıya geldi.

extraMeanings.en: to behave as if something is true when it is not
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The children pretended to be asleep.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar uyuyormuş gibi yaptı.

extraMeanings.en: courage and determination
extraMeanings.exampleEn: It took a lot of pluck to stand up to the bully.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Zorbaya karşı durmak epey cesaret istedi.

extraMeanings.en: to have or cause an unpleasant stinging feeling on the skin
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Her skin prickled with fear as she entered the dark room.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Karanlık odaya girerken teni korkuyla karıncalandı.
